episodes.discussion_prompt: Use the rehearsal captures to explain the selected perception project, one interface choice, an alternative, and what would make you switch. Identify what is actually saved and what remains only session practice.

concepts.experiment: Compare the road-object perception mission with another project, then choose a mission and identify its camera, onboard output path, and separate training host.
concepts.evidence: Inspect stakeholder and boundary cards; neither mission selection nor a device category establishes performance.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a different project better match the intended use?

concepts.experiment: On labeled rehearsal cases, predict a change, pin the camera-path baseline, capture a contrast, then move the live control again.
concepts.evidence: Inspect the unchanged capture beside the new live state and the recorded prediction; these are interface examples, not vehicle measurements.
concepts.transfer_question: When would you need a new capture rather than reuse the pinned one?

concepts.experiment: Try the available save/readback path and download a rehearsal discussion; inspect a supplied storage-failure case.
concepts.evidence: Distinguish a session capture, a verified stored record, and a downloaded file; inspect which fallback actually remains available.
concepts.transfer_question: When would downloading be necessary before leaving the notebook?

concepts.experiment: Build a rehearsal handoff from the selected mission and actual captured comparison, then inspect its contents.
concepts.evidence: Check project identity, prediction, captured state, and next question without interpreting the rehearsal as placement or safety approval.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a teammate need more context before using this handoff?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Using your captures, recommend an intervention or hold for the changed perception baseline, reject an alternative, and identify the outcome or execution evidence that would reverse your choice.

concepts.experiment: Keep the detector and runtime fixed while switching a supplied labeled capture-condition mixture.
concepts.evidence: Compare road-object outcomes and runtime health separately; an unlabeled input warning leaves behavioral damage unresolved.
concepts.transfer_question: When would collecting matched labels be preferable to changing hardware?

concepts.experiment: Pin the complete camera-to-record decomposition and change one supported compute, movement, or overhead capability.
concepts.evidence: Compare total time with the affected term and unchanged stages; flag any absent price or power evidence.
concepts.transfer_question: When would improving decode or transfer be preferable to a faster detector kernel?

concepts.experiment: Compare task-matched detector candidates against separately declared outcome, frame-age, memory, and power requirements.
concepts.evidence: Inspect each pass, failure, and unknown rather than averaging them into a winner; generic classification evidence cannot establish road-object quality.
concepts.transfer_question: When would retaining the baseline or holding be preferable to the fastest candidate?

concepts.experiment: On the separate training host, compare supported sample-count, work-per-sample, and execution-efficiency interventions.
concepts.evidence: Inspect work and elapsed-time consequences beside matched quality evidence or its absence; fewer frames cannot imply an equally useful detector.
concepts.transfer_question: When would changing data allocation be preferable to optimizing host execution?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use the captured placement comparisons to defend onboard, permitted remote work, partitioning, or hold, including the rejected path and the condition that would reverse the decision.

concepts.experiment: Compare onboard processing with supported remote raw-frame or partitioned paths, then challenge a remote path with ideal compute.
concepts.evidence: Inspect transmission, applicable propagation, local preprocessing, and complete-path frame age; a passing lower bound still leaves real-path evidence missing.
concepts.transfer_question: When would off-device processing become preferable for a non-live evaluation task?

concepts.experiment: Hold the detector task fixed and change the binding resident-memory allocation or supported capacity.
concepts.evidence: Inspect weights, activations, frame buffers, and runtime reservations separately; a nonfitting path has no executable timing claim.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a different representation be preferable to more arithmetic throughput?

concepts.experiment: Change supported frame-observation policy or node operating allowance while preserving the stated observation requirement.
concepts.evidence: Inspect retained and lost observations, complete-window energy, and sustained power separately; the powered node is not assigned an invented battery.
concepts.transfer_question: When would observing fewer frames be unacceptable despite lower energy?

concepts.experiment: Review saved locality, capacity, and operating evidence; vary a connection or data-permission condition and choose placement or hold.
concepts.evidence: Compare surviving paths, rejected alternatives, and unpriced partition/quality obligations; remote logging does not authorize remote real-time steering.
concepts.transfer_question: Which changed requirement would reverse your placement?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use the dependency and retest captures to defend a bicycle-extension advance, restriction, or hold, reject another response, and name the evidence that would reopen it.

concepts.experiment: Add the bicycle-output requirement and mark which annotation, transform, detector-output, package, and test artifacts must change.
concepts.evidence: Inspect preserved and invalidated evidence links; changing the output label contract is more than repackaging.
concepts.transfer_question: When would restricting the evaluation envelope be preferable to revising the whole dependency chain?

concepts.experiment: Discover the same bicycle label-contract defect at different development stages with the repair tasks held fixed.
concepts.evidence: Inspect checking effort, downstream rework, and elapsed schedule separately rather than inventing one scalar cost.
concepts.transfer_question: When would an earlier check justify its additional effort?

concepts.experiment: Choose a bicycle-extension repair bundle, then rerun the affected gate against its exact package identity.
concepts.evidence: Compare detected failure, repaired-but-unverified, missing evidence, and supported pass; the old package cannot inherit the new task claim.
concepts.transfer_question: When would holding be preferable to advancing a repaired candidate?

concepts.experiment: Replay a fixed field-warning and annotation timeline, then choose the responsible owner and next evidence request.
concepts.evidence: Inspect what changed inputs and selectively reviewed frames can support before independent object outcomes arrive.
concepts.transfer_question: When would requesting an audit be preferable to immediately retraining?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use captured split, annotation, transform, and feeding comparisons to defend the next data-contract action, reject an alternative, and state when you would reverse the decision.

concepts.experiment: Spend a supplied annotation budget on more road frames or targeted bicycle-boundary adjudication, and compare rubrics.
concepts.evidence: Inspect disagreement, unresolved objects, and rubric-dependent evaluations without rewriting stored predictions; agreement alone is not truth.
concepts.transfer_question: When would resolving ambiguous labels be preferable to labeling more frames?

concepts.experiment: Compare frame-random and drive/session-held-out splits, then toggle fit-on-train versus fit-before-split and frozen versus refitted preprocessing.
concepts.evidence: Inspect adjacent-frame overlap, fitted-state identity, and held-out outcomes; better-looking leaked evidence is not better road perception.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a stricter session split be preferable despite a weaker headline result?

concepts.experiment: Keep image meaning fixed while changing supported storage representation, decode supply, or consumer capacity on the training host.
concepts.evidence: Inspect read/decode/transform and detector demand together; smaller files may trade less transfer for more decoding.
concepts.transfer_question: When would retaining a larger representation be preferable to further compression?

concepts.experiment: Replay a camera calibration, channel-order, or resize-contract mismatch, quarantine affected frames, and apply a supported repair.
concepts.evidence: Inspect request-keyed transformed values and affected dataset descendants; a valid schema or distribution alert alone does not prove semantic correctness or damage.
concepts.transfer_question: When would investigation without quarantine be preferable to treating an alert as confirmed corruption?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use the shape and state captures to defend a detector configuration and phase-specific resource plan, reject an alternative, and explain the capacity or task change that would reverse it.

concepts.experiment: Change a supported detector layer or input shape and inspect its linear maps and nonlinear stages. Contrast a deeper linear composition with a supplied task that requires a nonlinear mapping.
concepts.evidence: Compare layer work, parameter storage, and activation allocations; a smaller parameter file need not mean a smaller working set or adequate localization behavior.
concepts.transfer_question: When would preserving input detail be preferable to reducing shape?

concepts.experiment: Step through a small detector-training dependency graph and remove or restore a saved forward value.
concepts.evidence: Inspect the derivative dependencies and missing-state failure; absent state is not a zero gradient.
concepts.transfer_question: When would recomputing a value be preferable to retaining it?

concepts.experiment: Compare endpoint inference with training the same candidate on its separate host, then vary batch with format and optimizer fixed.
concepts.evidence: Inspect weights, activations, gradients, and optimizer state separately; endpoint fit cannot establish training-host fit.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a phase-specific memory intervention be preferable to shrinking the model?

concepts.experiment: Grow a supported development batch while keeping the task and numerical format fixed.
concepts.evidence: Compare weight movement per useful example with activation residency and capacity; this experiment does not select a live frame-serving policy.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a smaller batch be preferable despite weaker reuse?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use native matched-task captures to defend a detector architecture or hold, reject an alternative, and name the evidence that would change your choice. Keep sequence and embedding reference observations explicitly separate.

concepts.experiment: Compare supplied road-object detector candidates or input transformations under the same localization and bicycle-output requirement.
concepts.evidence: Inspect matched detection evidence beside cost; a transformation that preserves object presence may erase location or small-object detail.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a more expensive candidate be preferable for the required outputs?

concepts.experiment: Trace supported dense, local/shared, and attention-based detector operations onto work, movement, and live state.
concepts.evidence: Inspect candidate-specific resource signatures rather than treating an architecture family as a guaranteed performance ranking.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a different inductive bias be preferable on this task and target?

concepts.experiment: In the separately labeled Language sequence reference, hold history fixed and compare materialized versus unmaterialized attention scores, then compare prefill and decode.
concepts.evidence: Inspect optional score storage beside unchanged quadratic dense score arithmetic at fixed history, retained state, and phase-specific resource demands. This is reference evidence, not a detector workload.
concepts.transfer_question: When would eliminating score materialization be preferable to shortening supported history?

concepts.experiment: In an explicitly separate embedding-table reference study, grow the supported table while keeping requested rows fixed.
concepts.evidence: Inspect resident capacity and per-request access separately; this is not a native perception embedding workload or evidence for unseen object quality.
concepts.transfer_question: When would reducing table capacity be preferable to improving lookup throughput?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use the graph and target-support captures to defend an execution plan or hold, reject an alternative, and identify the reuse horizon or compatibility change that would reverse your choice.

concepts.experiment: Compare eager, captured, and supported fused execution for the same detector graph at a named host or endpoint location.
concepts.evidence: Inspect launch overhead and intermediate movement separately; fewer dispatches do not imply that detector arithmetic disappeared.
concepts.transfer_question: When would keeping eager boundaries be preferable to greater fusion?

concepts.experiment: Vary graph reuse horizon and supported input-signature churn for the same bicycle-capable detector.
concepts.evidence: Compare compilation/setup work with invocation savings over the actual horizon; a faster steady-state invocation may not repay preparation.
concepts.transfer_question: When would avoiding compilation be preferable?

concepts.experiment: Reuse the earlier training dependency graph and choose saved-value versus recomputation policies on the development host.
concepts.evidence: Inspect reverse traversal, retained state, and additional work; automatic differentiation still requires the same mathematical dependencies.
concepts.transfer_question: When would lower retained state justify more execution?

concepts.experiment: Try the exact required graph with native support, explicit partition/fallback, and a rejected export case.
concepts.evidence: Inspect supported operators, boundary transfers, and unchanged preprocessing/postprocessing semantics; removing required detection stages changes the task.
concepts.transfer_question: When would holding export be preferable to accepting fallback?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use training-host captures and matched progress evidence to defend a bicycle-capable training recipe or hold, reject an alternative, and state the quality or resource condition that would reverse it.

concepts.experiment: Compare full and supported restricted adaptation of the bicycle-capable detector on the separate training host.
concepts.evidence: Inspect weights, gradients, optimizer state, and saved activations separately; frozen parameters can leave necessary forward/backward dependencies.
concepts.transfer_question: When would full adaptation be preferable despite greater state?

concepts.experiment: Recover a nonfitting host-training recipe using supported micro-batching/accumulation or checkpointing at matched effective batch where justified.
concepts.evidence: Inspect peak state, recomputation, update recipe, and execution cost; equal batch labels alone do not establish equivalent learning.
concepts.transfer_question: When would checkpointing be preferable to changing the effective batch?

concepts.experiment: Compare supported precision/training recipes and reveal their supplied matched progress histories.
concepts.evidence: Inspect time to the bicycle-inclusive outcome target, failed targets, and unavailable evidence separately from step time.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a slower update recipe be preferable?

concepts.experiment: Reveal parts of a training profile, test an irrelevant upgrade, then change the supported binding stage.
concepts.evidence: Inspect useful progress and critical-path timing; busy accelerators and fast input delivery do not establish successful learning.
concepts.transfer_question: When would retaining the recipe and improving preparation be preferable to another accelerator?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use coverage, campaign, and loading captures to defend a selected dataset or full pool, reject an alternative, and identify when changing task or reuse would reverse the choice.

concepts.experiment: Choose supported road-scene allocation pilots and compare work-matched observed learning on the fixed bicycle-inclusive target.
concepts.evidence: Inspect complete target-reaching evidence and uncertainty; an attractive early gain does not establish the final detector target.
concepts.transfer_question: When would the larger training pool be preferable?

concepts.experiment: Allocate a finite subset across supported object and capture-condition coverage floors, including difficult bicycle frames.
concepts.evidence: Inspect discarded alternatives, missing eligible examples, and infeasible budgets; counts alone do not establish sufficient object outcomes.
concepts.transfer_question: When would spending more labeling or selection budget be preferable to pruning?

concepts.experiment: Compare supported scoring policies across reuse horizons while retaining the same accepted quality obligation.
concepts.evidence: Inspect scorer preparation, refresh, selection, and training work; a new camera or bicycle requirement can invalidate reuse.
concepts.transfer_question: When would keeping the full pool be preferable to paying for selection?

concepts.experiment: Hold selected frame identities fixed and compare stream/discard, scattered reads, and materialized subset delivery.
concepts.evidence: Inspect archive scanning, repacking, storage, and realized training-host supply; fewer selected records need not reduce critical-path loading.
concepts.transfer_question: When would materialization repay its preparation cost?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use exact artifact captures to defend a supported detector package or hold, reject an alternative, and name the quality, capacity, or execution evidence that would reverse the decision.

concepts.experiment: Change a supported detector representation while inspecting storage and live memory separately.
concepts.evidence: Compare checkpoint size, activations, frame buffers, runtime reservations, and the binding limit; a smaller file may not repair endpoint fit.
concepts.transfer_question: When would changing the input or buffer policy be preferable to compressing weights?

concepts.experiment: Compare supplied post-training and training-aware numerical artifacts on matched road-object calibration and held-out cases.
concepts.evidence: Inspect bicycle/capture-condition outcomes, resource gates, and preparation work; a technique name does not guarantee quality recovery.
concepts.transfer_question: When would retaining higher precision be preferable?

concepts.experiment: Compare masked, indexed sparse, structurally reduced, and supported low-precision execution paths for the exact artifact.
concepts.evidence: Inspect metadata, conversion, movement, kernel support, and runtime separately; stored zeros cannot establish acceleration.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a dense supported path be preferable to a smaller sparse file?

concepts.experiment: Compare exact ordered compression combinations with their constituent artifacts.
concepts.evidence: Inspect joint task outcomes, state, runtime support, and preparation; missing combined evidence stays unknown rather than multiplying isolated gains.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a single transformation be preferable to the combined package?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use legal mapping and full-path captures to defend a hardware/dataflow intervention or baseline retention, reject an alternative, and identify the changed bottleneck that would reverse the choice.

concepts.experiment: Compare arithmetic, operand bandwidth, and supported reuse interventions for the selected detector kernel at its named interface.
concepts.evidence: Inspect the relevant roofline bound and regime; peak arithmetic is irrelevant when operand supply still binds.
concepts.transfer_question: When would more bandwidth be preferable to more arithmetic units?

concepts.experiment: Step through supported stationary dataflows for detector work and choose which operand stays resident.
concepts.evidence: Count weight, activation, and partial-sum movement with the supplied movement-energy model; saving one traffic class can increase another.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a different stationary schedule be preferable?

concepts.experiment: Grow a supported tile, cross live-buffer or accumulator limits, and compare aligned and fringe-heavy alternatives.
concepts.evidence: Inspect legality, reuse, live state, and useful versus padded work; illegal tiles receive no invented runtime.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a smaller legal tile be preferable to greater theoretical reuse?

concepts.experiment: Carry the legal kernel intervention through camera ingestion, decode, host work, transfers, and detector postprocessing.
concepts.evidence: Inspect complete frame-to-record consequences and retained fallback stages; unchanged work caps the local benefit.
concepts.transfer_question: When would improving a nonaccelerated stage be preferable to another kernel optimization?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use protocol and population captures to defend a bounded perception claim or withhold it, reject a broader claim, and state what additional evidence would change the decision.

concepts.experiment: Compare a warm isolated detector claim with the proposed camera-to-object claim, then repair timer boundaries and included stages.
concepts.evidence: Inspect exact artifact, preprocessing, inputs, and measured endpoints; a correct narrow timing does not support a complete-path claim.
concepts.transfer_question: When would publishing a narrower claim be preferable to asserting an unsupported system result?

concepts.experiment: Allocate the supplied measurement budget between frames within runs and independent paired runs.
concepts.evidence: Inspect within-drive and between-run variation and uncertainty beside the useful improvement threshold; correlated frames are not independent repetitions.
concepts.transfer_question: When would more independent runs be preferable to more adjacent frames?

concepts.experiment: Replay supported sustained and difficult-capture traces under the same candidate and requirement.
concepts.evidence: Inspect frame-age tails, missed observation deadlines, dropped frames, and complete-window energy beside average execution.
concepts.transfer_question: When would restricting the operating envelope be preferable to keeping a favorable aggregate claim?

concepts.experiment: Lock detection outcome obligations before revealing paired object/capture slices and supplied calibration evidence.
concepts.evidence: Inspect consequential differences and missing populations, then test only a supported repair; calibrated confidence and unchanged detections are distinct results.
concepts.transfer_question: When would requesting additional annotations be preferable to recalibration?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use identical-arrival captures to defend a frame-service policy, reject an alternative, and specify when frame age, lost observations, or capacity would make you switch.

concepts.experiment: Compare supported host and detector interventions on the same camera-to-output path.
concepts.evidence: Inspect ingestion, decode, transfer, inference, and postprocessing together; a faster forward pass may add work elsewhere.
concepts.transfer_question: When would improving upstream preparation be preferable to changing the detector?

concepts.experiment: Replay identical frame arrivals at fixed admission under two supported service-capacity cases on the onboard endpoint. Compare headroom before testing explicit admission or stale-frame dropping.
concepts.evidence: Inspect utilization, waiting, backlog, frame age, and tails as the same arrival trace approaches service capacity. Separately count lost observations under overload responses; no extra hardware is created by a worker widget.
concepts.transfer_question: When would dropping stale frames be preferable to retaining every frame?

concepts.experiment: Compare immediate dispatch with supported frame batching on identical arrivals.
concepts.evidence: Inspect formation delay, realized batches, executed work, frame age, and lost observations; waiting can grow without useful batching savings.
concepts.transfer_question: When would immediate dispatch be preferable despite lower throughput?

concepts.experiment: Cross and recover supported frame-buffer/concurrency capacity without changing required detector work. In the separately labeled Language-serving reference, compare prefill/decode demands and a supported KV-limited concurrency change.
concepts.evidence: Inspect model residency, live frames, and runtime state separately; any generative phase/KV comparison remains an explicitly separate reference study. Keep first-token delay, active-stream cadence, and KV residency separate from native task state.
concepts.transfer_question: When would reducing buffered work be preferable to a larger memory reservation?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use incident replay and recovery captures to defend a containment and recovery action, reject an alternative, and state the evidence that would require a different response.

concepts.experiment: Choose a monitor and replay the supplied early-warning and delayed road-object annotation windows.
concepts.evidence: Inspect alert sensitivity, confirmation delay, and response work; changed inputs or healthy processes alone cannot establish perception harm.
concepts.transfer_question: When would investigation be preferable to immediate model replacement?

concepts.experiment: Replay original frame identities through exact release transforms and compare request-keyed tensors and outputs.
concepts.evidence: Inspect calibration, resize, model, runtime, and manifest identity; similar aggregate distributions can hide incompatible per-frame transformations.
concepts.transfer_question: When would repairing preprocessing be preferable to retraining?

concepts.experiment: Vary supported staged-evaluation exposure while reserving the actual baseline and candidate copies.
concepts.evidence: Inspect resident-memory feasibility and strength of matched evidence separately from the fraction of frames exposed; a small exposure does not imply a small copy.
concepts.transfer_question: When would sequential evaluation be preferable to simultaneous candidate/baseline execution?

concepts.experiment: Try reverting weights alone, then recover the compatible calibration/transform/model/runtime bundle and contrast a changed road population.
concepts.evidence: Inspect paired replay and outcome evidence after recovery; rollback cannot repair a population outside the previously supported envelope.
concepts.transfer_question: When would restricted evaluation or new data be preferable to rollback?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use independent outcomes, audit, mitigation, and lifecycle captures to defend restricted evaluation, baseline retention, mitigation, or hold, reject an alternative, and identify the evidence or obligation that would reverse it.

concepts.experiment: State the native perception purpose and object/capture-condition obligations. Then use a separately labeled Fairness-policy reference: compare exposure parity and equal opportunity on audited recommendations for affected seller groups with different relevance base rates.
concepts.evidence: Keep native bicycle/capture robustness evidence separate from reference affected-population fairness. In the reference, inspect group counts, base rates, and criterion-dependent pass/fail/insufficient gates at fixed recommendations; no perception fairness or driving approval follows.
concepts.transfer_question: What affected-population evidence would you need before transferring a fairness criterion from the reference to this perception project?

concepts.experiment: Compare supported detector or audit options under native perception obligations. In the separately labeled Fairness-policy reference, hold A's justified criterion and audited cases fixed while comparing supplied mitigation candidates.
concepts.evidence: Keep native miss, false-detection, timing, and resource consequences separate from the reference fairness/quality frontier and mitigation preparation cost. A reference mitigation does not establish a fair perception package.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a costly reference mitigation be justified, and what native population evidence would be needed before applying that argument here?

concepts.experiment: Compare permitted random audits with review triggered only by high-confidence detections or reported failures.
concepts.evidence: Inspect supplied annotated outcomes and what each review policy leaves invisible, including missed bicycles; selective logs do not identify population-wide quality.
concepts.transfer_question: When would paying for independent audit coverage be preferable to collecting more triggered reviews?

concepts.experiment: Compare supported data-retention, evaluation, and package alternatives at equal useful observation service under a declared lifecycle boundary.
concepts.evidence: Inspect separate dollars, energy, emissions, preparation, operation, and privacy/retention obligations; excluded vehicle systems remain excluded.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a costlier operating option be preferable once preparation and obligations are counted?

episodes.discussion_prompt: Use compatible captured records to defend one exact perception evaluation package, restriction, or hold, reject an alternative, and demonstrate a changed condition that reverses your recommendation. Separate useful perception evidence from any unestablished driving-safety claim.

concepts.experiment: Audit the proposed evaluation dossier and accept or reject earlier records by exact requirement, data, package, runtime, protocol, and population identities.
concepts.evidence: Inspect compatible supporting chains and missing or stale links; completing notebooks does not establish a coherent release case.
concepts.transfer_question: When would a smaller compatible dossier be preferable to many unrelated passing records?

concepts.experiment: Reuse a supported earlier detector or service-policy contrast for the exact proposed package and operating envelope.
concepts.evidence: Inspect joint road-object outcomes, live state, timing, and useful observations rather than composing isolated green results.
concepts.transfer_question: When would the rejected baseline become preferable on the complete path?

concepts.experiment: Tighten a supported power, frame-age, memory, or observation obligation without rewriting captured consumption.
concepts.evidence: Inspect which acceptance gate changes and whether a supported restriction, recovery, or hold preserves the requirement.
concepts.transfer_question: Which changed obligation would reverse your recommendation?

concepts.experiment: Apply a supported camera-path or road-population change and choose a cause-specific response using earlier instruments.
concepts.evidence: Inspect expired physical and behavioral claims separately and name the next decisive evidence; no perception package certifies vehicle control or driving safety.
concepts.transfer_question: When would returning to data or requirements be preferable to changing the runtime?

provenance.numerical_status: Intended experiments; matched numerical fixtures and observed outcome evidence require separate implementation and validation.
